response.rationale: All options map to the same top-ranked leaf 'Disseminated strongyloidiasis (Strongyloides stercoralis hyperinfection syndrome)' with equivalent relation and identical support/confidence scores. To establish a strict total order, I prioritize options that provide more specific details aligning with the vignette. Option C explicitly mentions 'Disseminated Strongyloides stercoralis infection with ocular involvement (choroiditis)', which directly reflects the autopsy findings of 'focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posterior choroid with larval sections' and 'Coiled, incompletely sectioned filariform larva within a medium-caliber artery' in the eyes. Options A, B, and D are more general descriptions of strongyloidiasis hyperinfection syndrome without the specific ocular detail, making C the most comprehensive and precise match to the provided information.
